movies.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl

movies.title: Life in a Year

movies.overview: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.

movies.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

movies.title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time

As their connection intensifies, so does the temptation to throw the rules out the window and embrace that attraction.

movies.country: United States of America, India, United Arab Emirates

All of reality is at stake as the Doctor's own dangerous past comes back to haunt him.

Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why.

In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?

movies.title: Bicycle Thieves

movies.overview: Unemployed Antonio is elated when he finally finds work hanging posters around war-torn Rome. However on his first day, his bicycle—essential to his work—gets stolen. His job is doomed unless he can find the thief. With the help of his son, Antonio combs the city, becoming desperate for justice.

movies.title: The Departed
movies.cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Matt Damon, Jack Nicholson, Mark Wahlberg, Martin Sheen, Ray Winstone
movies.country: Hong Kong, United States of America
movies.overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. While an undercover cop curries favor with the mob kingpin, a career criminal rises through the police ranks. But both sides soon discover there's a mole among them.

movies.title: Wolfwalkers
movies.cast: Honor Kneafsey, Eva Whittaker, Sean Bean, Simon McBurney, Tommy Tiernan, Maria Doyle Kennedy
movies.country: France, Ireland, Luxembourg, United States of America, China
movies.overview: In a time of superstition and magic, when wolves are seen as demonic and nature an evil to be tamed, a young apprentice hunter comes to Ireland with her father to wipe out the last pack. But when she saves a wild native girl, their friendship leads her to discover the world of the Wolfwalkers and transform her into the very thing her father is tasked to destroy.

movies.title: Scarface
movies.cast: Al Pacino, Steven Bauer, Michelle Pfeiffer, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Robert Loggia, Miriam Colon
movies.overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

movies.title: Love Hurts
movies.cast: Luis Fernando Peña, Martha Higareda, Ximena Sariñana, Alfonso Herrera, Armando Hernández, Andrea Damián
movies.overview: Family and friends try to sabotage the budding romance between a young upper class girl and a humble student.

movies.title: Tokyo Story
movies.cast: Chishū Ryū, Chieko Higashiyama, Setsuko Hara, Haruko Sugimura, So Yamamura, Kuniko Miyake
movies.overview: The elderly Shukishi and his wife, Tomi, take the long journey from their small seaside village to visit their adult children in Tokyo. Their elder son, Koichi, a doctor, and their daughter, Shige, a hairdresser, don't have much time to spend with their aged parents, and so it falls to Noriko, the widow of their younger son who was killed in the war, to keep her in-laws company.

movies.title: Casablanca
movies.cast: Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, Paul Henreid, Claude Rains, Conrad Veidt, Sydney Greenstreet
movies.overview: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.

movies.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
movies.original_title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
movies.cast: Kevin Costner, Milo Ventimiglia, Amanda Seyfried, Ryan Kiera Armstrong, Lily Dodsworth-Evans, Ian Lake
movies.overview: A family dog – with a near-human soul and a philosopher's mind – evaluates his life through the lessons learned by his human owner, a race-car driver.

movies.title: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
movies.original_title: さよならの朝に約束の花をかざろう
movies.cast: Manaka Iwami, Miyu Irino, Yuuki Sakurai, Ai Kayano, Yuki Kaji, Yoshimasa Hosoya
movies.overview: Fleeing the war, the immortal Maquia, graced with eternal youth, finds a baby abandoned in the forest and decides to raise it as her own child, sparking a moving story between a mortal and a being who does not age.

movies.title: Breeder
movies.cast: Daniel Doheny, Dot-Marie Jones, Maddie Phillips, Tanaya Beatty, Paige McGarvin, Carmen Moore
movies.overview: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

movies.title: Klara and the Sun
movies.cast: Jenna Ortega, Amy Adams, Mia Tharia, Aran Murphy, Steve Buscemi, Natasha Lyonne
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

movies.title: Fatherland
movies.cast: Sandra Hüller, Hanns Zischler, August Diehl, Anna Madeley, Devid Striesow, David Menkin
movies.country: Poland, Germany, France, Italy, United Kingdom
movies.overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

movies.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
movies.cast: Joshua Garcia, Julia Barretto, Chanda Romero, Bianca Umali, Joy Barcoma, Karen Reyes
movies.overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

movies.title: A Very Arctic Christmas
movies.cast: Cameron Mathison, Maya Skabar, Jill Wagner, Kendon Chase, Tonjha Richardson, John James
movies.overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

movies.title: DNK
movies.cast: Mouli, Sushmita Shetty, Ali, Raghu Babu, Rajitha, Bhadram
movies.overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood
movies.original_title: Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood
movies.cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt, Margot Robbie, Emile Hirsch, Margaret Qualley, Timothy Olyphant
movies.country: China, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Los Angeles, 1969. TV star Rick Dalton, a struggling actor specializing in westerns, and stuntman Cliff Booth, his best friend, try to survive in a constantly changing movie industry. Dalton is the neighbor of the young and promising actress and model Sharon Tate, who has just married the prestigious Polish director Roman Polanski…

movies.title: Kung Fu Soccer
movies.cast: Zhang Xiaofei, Dilraba Dilmurat, Zhang Yixing, Carina Lau, Hu Yu'an, Sisley Choi Si-pui
movies.overview: Dismissed as underdogs before they even step onto the pitch, the Emei Women's Football Team enters the prestigious Supreme Invincible Cup determined to prove everyone wrong. Led by captain Shuangshuang, star striker Yulong, and mentor Xu Feng, the team combines martial arts mastery with football skill in a thrilling quest for victory. Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

movies.title: Mouse
movies.cast: Sophie Okonedo, Katherine Mallen Kupferer, Chloe Coleman, David Hyde Pierce, Tara Mallen, Iman Vellani
movies.overview: In 2002 Arkansas, Callie and Minnie’s friendship is suddenly upended the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her best friend, Minnie forms a complicated bond with Callie’s mother.

movies.title: Bitter Christmas
movies.cast: Bárbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Victoria Luengo, Patrick Criado, Milena Smit
movies.overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

movies.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
movies.original_title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
movies.cast: Ozzy Osbourne, Jason Momoa, Tony Iommi, Geezer Butler, Bill Ward, Zakk Wylde
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

movies.title: Hershey
movies.cast: Finn Wittrock, Alexandra Daddario, Alan Ruck, Richard Kind, David Costabile, Heléne Yorke
movies.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

movies.title: The Holiday
movies.cast: Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law, Jack Black, Eli Wallach, Edward Burns
movies.overview: Two women, one American and one British, swap homes at Christmastime following bad breakups. Each woman finds romance with a local man but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.

movies.title: Lilo & Scratch
movies.cast: Chris Sanders, Maia Kealoha
movies.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

movies.title: All of a Sudden
movies.cast: Virginie Efira, Tao Okamoto, Kyōzō Nagatsuka, Kodai Kurosaki, Jean-Charles Clichet, Marie Bunel
movies.overview: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

movies.title: November 1963
movies.cast: John Travolta, Robert Carlyle, Dermot Mulroney, Jefferson White, Mandy Patinkin, Thomas Fiscella
movies.country: United States of America, Canada, Germany
movies.overview: Prior to the election of John F. Kennedy in 1960, his father Joe Kennedy asked for a favor from mob boss Sam Giancana and the Chicago Outfit to ensure a win for the younger Kennedy. However, during the presidency, the national organized crime syndicate came under heavy fire from Attorney General Bobby Kennedy. The mob answered this perceived betrayal with the ultimate revenge: the assassination of the 35th President of the United States on November 22, 1963. The events are depicted through the perspective of Sam Giancana's brother, Pepe, who was present during the critical planning stages, detailing the intricate circumstances and the mob's direct involvement in setting up the assassination.

movies.title: The Debut
movies.cast: Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti, Halle Bailey, Colton Ryan, Eldar Isgandarov, K. Todd Freeman
movies.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movies.title: Ray Gunn
movies.cast: Sam Rockwell, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Waits, Matt Berry, Kathryn Hunter, Alan Tudyk
movies.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

movies.title: The Muppets
movies.cast: Jason Segel, Amy Adams, Chris Cooper, Rashida Jones, Steve Whitmire, Peter Linz
movies.overview: When Kermit the Frog and the Muppets learn that their beloved theater is slated for demolition, a sympathetic human, Gary, and his felt-faced brother, Walter, swoop in to help the gang put on a telethon show and raise the $10 million they need to save the day.

movies.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.cast: Deva Cassel, Jamie Ward, Jim Caviezel, Sam Worthington, Ben Mendelsohn, Gael García Bernal
movies.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

movies.title: Rose
movies.cast: Sandra Hüller, Caro Braun, Marisa Growaldt, Robert Gwisdek, Godehard Giese, Maria Dragus
movies.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

movies.title: Ink
movies.cast: Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce, Claire Foy, Blake Harrison, Patrick Kennedy, Angus Imrie
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France
movies.overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb banded together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

movies.title: Flavia
movies.cast: Molly Belle Wright, Martin Freeman, Toby Jones, Jonathan Pryce, Annette Badland, Karan Gill
movies.country: United Kingdom, Canada, United States of America
movies.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

movies.title: The Gallerist
movies.cast: Natalie Portman, Jenna Ortega, Zach Galifianakis, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Sterling K. Brown, Daniel Brühl
movies.overview: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

movies.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
movies.cast: George Michael
movies.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

movies.title: Tangles
movies.cast: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Abbi Jacobson, Bryan Cranston, Samira Wiley, Beanie Feldstein, Seth Rogen
movies.overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

movies.title: Above the Below
movies.cast: Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, Hero Fiennes Tiffin
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

movies.title: The Fox
movies.cast: Jai Courtney, Emily Browning, Olivia Colman, Claudia Doumit, Peter O'Brien, Sam Neill
movies.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

movies.title: Tender Loving Care
movies.cast: Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson, Kate O'Flynn, Alice Bailey Johnson, Tilly Vosburgh, Alan Williams
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Singapore
movies.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

movies.title: Bunker
movies.cast: Javier Bardem, Penélope Cruz, Stephen Graham, Paul Dano, Patrick Schwarzenegger, Chloe Conh
movies.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

movies.title: In Waves
movies.cast: Rio Vega, Lyna Khoudri, Paul Kircher, Birane Ba, Gauthier Battoue, Taiana Tully
movies.country: France, Belgium, United States of America
movies.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

movies.title: GROTESQQQUE
movies.cast: Kana Ichinose, Gen Hoshino, Sara Minami, Ikumi Hasegawa, Saori Hayami, Maaya Uchida
movies.overview: An alien girl wants to be her planet's ambassador to be able to present herself on Earth. A group of high school students take part in a violent battle royale game called The Queen of Butterflies. A pure-blooded, female vampire lives with her servants in a world where humanity has become extinct.

movies.title: A Long Winter
movies.cast: Fred Hechinger, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Caitríona Balfe, Kit Connor, D'Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai, David Furr
movies.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

movies.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
movies.cast: Cameron Winter
movies.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

movies.title: Killing Castro
movies.cast: Diego Boneta, Xolo Maridueña, KiKi Layne, Al Pacino, Alexander Ludwig, Kendrick Sampson
movies.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

movies.title: Clarissa
movies.cast: Sophie Okonedo, David Oyelowo, India Ria Amarteifio, Ayo Edebiri, Toheeb Jimoh, Nikki Amuka-Bird
movies.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

movies.title: Eternal Return
movies.cast: Naomi Scott, Kit Harington, Sonoya Mizuno, Jay Lycurgo, Simon Callow
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming

movies.title: Ben'Imana
movies.cast: Clémentine U. Nyirinkindi, Kesia Kelly Nishimwe, Arivere Kagoyire, Isabelle Kabano, Antoinette Uwamahoro, Leocadie Uwabeza
movies.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

movies.title: 14th
movies.cast: Sherrilyn Ifill, Stacey Abrams, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jeff Flake, Hasan Piker, Alex Padilla
movies.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

movies.title: The Day She Returns
movies.cast: Song Seon-mi, Cho Yun-hee, Park Mi-so, Kim Sun-jin, O Yoon-soo, Kang So-yi
movies.overview: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

movies.title: Starlight
movies.cast: Michael Brando, Irmena Chichikova, Cassie Clare, Ruby Kammer, Brice Bexter, Lesley Conroy
movies.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

movies.title: To Hold a Mountain
movies.cast: Mileva Gara Jovanović, Nada Stanišić
movies.country: Serbia, France, Montenegro, Slovenia, Croatia, Belgium
movies.overview: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

movies.title: A Little Dream of Me
movies.original_title: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi
movies.cast: Kaycee, Trần Doãn Hoàng, Nguyễn Hùng, Hữu Châu, Phương Nam, Tào Nhân
movies.overview: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi is an emotional journey of young people searching for answers to the question, “What is your dream?”—only to discover, as they step into adulthood, that the most important question becomes, “Who do you want to pursue that dream with?”

movies.title: The Friend's House is Here
movies.cast: Mahshad Bahram, Hana Mana, Farzad Karen, Zohreh Pirnia, Parham Ghanavat, Erfan Tehranifar
movies.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

movies.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
movies.original_title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
movies.cast: Tom Sizemore, Robert LaSardo, Celine Alva, Daniel Baldwin, Tony Devon, Bai Ling
movies.country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

movies.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
movies.cast: Soraya Akhlaghi
movies.country: Iran, France, United Kingdom, United States of America, Denmark
movies.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

movies.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
movies.original_title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
movies.cast: Jeevan Braich, Kayna Montecillo, Jade Marvin, Olivia Ringrose, Asher Forth, Sophie Naglik
movies.overview: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.

movies.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
movies.original_title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
movies.cast: Aoife Josie Clements, Louise Weard, Ada Rook, Vera Drew, Dakota Blais, Penny Andrews
movies.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

movies.title: Bad Medicine
movies.cast: Dr Michael Yeadon, Dr Paul Marik, Andrew Cuomo, Dr Vladimir Zelenko, Dr. Moehanid Talia, Erin Olszewsky
movies.overview: Bad Medicine follows the trail of hard evidence while laying out a step-by-step exposé of the tricks and tactics used to capture and control entire populations. Without understanding these methods we will remain vulnerable to future psychological operations.

movies.title: Alias Rukmini
movies.cast: Nithiin, Aafiya Sayed
movies.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

movies.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
movies.cast: Mark Lewis, Mike Majlak, Sam Dale, Sam Dale, Ben Kersley, Ben Kersley
movies.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

movies.title: Straight Circle
movies.cast: Elliott Tittensor, Luke Tittensor, Neil Maskell, Matthew Dylan Roberts, Camilla Waldman, Catriona Andrew
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

movies.title: Jane Elliott Against the World
movies.cast: Jane Elliott, Oprah Winfrey, Peter Jennings, Ted Koppel, Killer Mike, Yohuru Williams
movies.overview: A rural Iowa schoolteacher becomes a national voice against racism after leading a controversial 1968 lesson in discrimination with her all-white third-grade class. Now nearly 90, she refuses to hold back amid today’s fights about race, history, and power after a lifetime of speaking out.

movies.title: Drinking and Driving
movies.cast: Jillian Frank, Avalon Fast, Ethan Hawksworth, Henri Gillespi, Payton Berg, Sophie Bawks-Smith
movies.overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

movies.title: Who Is Still Alive
movies.cast: Jawdat Khoudary, Mahmoud Jouda, Adel Altaweel, Haneen Harara, Malak Khadra, Hana Eleiwa
movies.overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

movies.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
movies.cast: Soroya Clayton-Wright, Lil Champ, Loretta Robinson, Miles Caton, Guillaume Marbeck, Debbii Dawson
movies.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

movies.title: GAME
movies.cast: Marc Bessant, Jason Williamson, Alison Campbell, Nathan Benham, Ben Simmons, Ginger Brown
movies.overview: Late summer 1993. After stealing a stash of money and drugs, aging raver David crashes his car deep in the woods - trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher discovers him, no rescue comes, only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills, and wits, unfolds - where survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.​
